scanNote:
WORKBOOK 1-UNITNING TO'RTINChI (oxirgi) BETI (7-bet). Yuqorida o'ngda 'People around the World' va to'q sariq '1'.

CHAP USTUN - 'Reading':
15) 'Read the letter and answer the questions below.' XAT (pushti qog'oz, o'ngda 'Para 1'-'Para 6' belgilari): 'Via Diaz 29, 80134 Naples, Italy. 2nd August, ... Dear Carol, [Para 1] I can't believe I'm here in Naples on holiday! Everything is so different here. Do you remember the Bellinis? They live here now and I'm staying with them. They live in a beautiful old house close to the bay. At the moment, I'm having some ice cream and enjoying the wonderful view. [Para 2] The weather here is quite warm. Naples has over 400 churches and the city centre is clean. I spend most of my time with the Bellinis, walking along the waterfront or around the old city. [Para 3] Neapolitans really love their city. They're very friendly and like having fun. They're quite good-looking, too. Most of them have got dark hair and brown eyes. [Para 4] The food is excellent. Neapolitans like eating pizza, pasta and seafood. I love eating the fresh seafood here, especially shrimps. [Para 5] Tomorrow, I'm taking the train to Pompeii to see the Roman sites. I'm also going to visit the Teatro di San Carlo opera house. I'm leaving Naples next Wednesday, so I'll call you then. [Para 6] You really should visit Naples soon. It's a truly amazing city! See you soon. Yours, Mary'
  SAVOLLAR: 1 Which city is Mary in? 2 Where is she staying? 3 What's the weather like? 4 How does she spend her time? 5 What are Neapolitans like? 6 What do they look like? 7 What do they like eating? 8 What are Mary's plans? 9 How does she recommend Naples?
• 'Writing (a friendly letter)':
16a) 'Read the letter in Ex. 15 again and mark the sentences as T (true) or F (false). Then correct the false sentences.' 1 We write our address in the top left-hand corner. 2 We don't write the date after the address. 3 We start with Dear + the recipient's first name. 4 There aren't any paragraphs. 5 We can end with Yours + our first name.

O'NG USTUN:
16b) 'Match the headings to the paragraphs.' Plans ......, Recommendation ......, Location/Accommodation ......, People (Looks/Character) ......, Food ......, Weather/Sights/Activities ......
16c) 'Which of the phrases below can we use to end a friendly letter?' Qiya: Yours faithfully, Best wishes, Yours sincerely, Yours, Love, All the best.
17) 'Imagine you are on holiday in Brazil. Use the information below to write a letter to a friend (100-150 words). Use the letter in Ex. 15 as a model.' TO'Q SARIQ QUTILAR: Location/Accommodation: 3 Avenida N.S. Copacabana - CEP: 20394 - Rio de Janeiro - Brazil; staying with the Serpas; lovely house in Copacabana near beach - relax by pool. Weather/Sights/Activities: hot & sunny; visit Sugarloaf Mountain, walk around Botanical Gardens; explore city with the Serpas. People (Looks/Character): friendly, happy, love having fun; attractive, dark hair & brown eyes. Food: delicious; Brazilians love spicy food; I love tasty seafood & great coffee. Plans: tomorrow - drive - Petrópolis - enjoy mountain air - visit cathedral & Museum of the Empire; leave Rio next week. Recommendation: Rio - such a colourful city; must come here soon.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '7'.
⚠ Orqa tomondan (8-bet, 'Night and Day') sarlavha ko'chib ko'rinadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Via Diaz 29, 80134 Naples, Italy. 2nd August, ... Dear Carol, ... Yours, Mary
exercises.instructionUz: Via Diaz 29, 80134 Neapol, Italiya. 2-avgust, ... Aziz Kerol, ... Sening, Meri
exercises.explanationUz:
DO'STONA XAT - NEAPOLDAN.
  (coursebook 9-bet Syuzan xati
  bilan bir xil tuzilish)

TUZILISh:
  yuqori O'NG burchak: manzil + sana
  Dear + ism,
  6 xatboshi (Para 1-6)
  Yours, + ism


⚠ ITALYAN MANZILI:

  Via Diaz 29 = Diaz ko'chasi, 29-uy
  ('via' = ko'cha - italyancha)
  80134 = pochta indeksi
  Naples = Neapol (ital. Napoli)


⚠ 'NEAPOLITANS':

  = neapolliklar. Naples → Neapolitan
  (lotincha 'Neapolis' dan).


⚠ XATDAGI ZAMONLAR:

  Present continuous (hozir):
    I'm staying, I'm having,
    enjoying
  Present simple (odat/fakt):
    They live, Naples has, I spend,
    Neapolitans love
  Continuous (KELAJAK rejasi):
    I'm taking the train tomorrow,
    I'm leaving next Wednesday
  'going to' (reja): I'm going to
    visit
  'will' (va'da): I'll call you


⚠ 'I CAN'T BELIEVE ...':

  = Ishonolmayman ... - hayrat.


⚠ 'THE BELLINIS':

  = Bellinilar oilasi. 'the' + familiya
  + S = oila.


⚠ 'CLOSE TO THE BAY':

  'close to' = yaqin; 'a bay' =
  ko'rfaz (Neapol ko'rfazi).


⚠ 'THE WATERFRONT':

  = sohil bo'yi (shahar sohili).


⚠ POMPEII:

  = Pompey - Vezuviy otilishi (mil.
  79-y.) ko'mib yuborgan Rim shahri.
  'Roman sites' = Rim yodgorliklari.


⚠ TEATRO DI SAN CARLO:

  = Neapoldagi opera teatri (1737) -
  Yevropadagi eng qadimgi faol
  opera teatri.


⚠ 'YOU REALLY SHOULD VISIT':

  = albatta tashrif buyurishing
  kerak - TAVSIYA.


⚠ 'TRULY':

  = chindan, haqiqatan.

points.noteUz:
⚠ Manzil yuqori O'NG burchakda, keyin sana.
⚠ 'via' = ko'cha (italyancha).

points.en: I can't believe I'm here in Naples on holiday! Everything is so different here. Do you remember the Bellinis? They live here now and I'm staying with them. They live in a beautiful old house close to the bay. At the moment, I'm having some ice cream and enjoying the wonderful view.
points.uz: Neapolda ta'tilda ekanimga ishonolmayman! Bu yerda hamma narsa juda boshqacha. Bellinilarni eslaysanmi? Ular endi shu yerda yashashadi va men ularnikida turibman. Ular ko'rfazga yaqin chiroyli eski uyda yashashadi. Hozir muzqaymoq yeb, ajoyib manzaradan bahra olyapman.
points.noteUz:
⚠ PARA 1 - Joylashuv/Turar joy.
⚠ 'I'm staying WITH them' - ularnikida.
⚠ 'at the moment' → continuous.

points.en: The weather here is quite warm. Naples has over 400 churches and the city centre is clean. I spend most of my time with the Bellinis, walking along the waterfront or around the old city.
points.uz: Bu yerda ob-havo ancha iliq. Neapolda 400 dan ortiq cherkov bor va shahar markazi toza. Vaqtimning ko'p qismini Bellinilar bilan sohil bo'ylab yoki eski shahar bo'ylab sayr qilib o'tkazaman.
points.noteUz:
⚠ PARA 2 - Ob-havo/Manzaralar/Mashg'ulotlar.
⚠ 'spend time + V-ing' = vaqtni ... bilan o'tkazmoq.
⚠ 'over 400' = 400 dan ortiq.

points.en: Neapolitans really love their city. They're very friendly and like having fun. They're quite good-looking, too. Most of them have got dark hair and brown eyes.
points.uz: Neapolliklar shaharlarini juda yaxshi ko'rishadi. Ular juda samimiy va ko'ngil ochishni yaxshi ko'rishadi. Ular ancha chiroyli ham. Ko'pchiligining qora sochi va qo'ng'ir ko'zi bor.
points.noteUz:
⚠ PARA 3 - Odamlar (xarakter + qiyofa).
⚠ 'like + V-ing': 'like having fun'.
⚠ 'Most of them' = ko'pchiligi.

points.en: The food is excellent. Neapolitans like eating pizza, pasta and seafood. I love eating the fresh seafood here, especially shrimps.
points.uz: Ovqat a'lo. Neapolliklar pitsa, makaron va dengiz mahsulotlarini yeyishni yaxshi ko'rishadi. Men bu yerdagi yangi dengiz mahsulotlarini, ayniqsa krevetkalarni yeyishni yaxshi ko'raman.
points.noteUz:
⚠ PARA 4 - Ovqat.
⚠ Pitsa Neapolda paydo bo'lgan!
⚠ 'shrimps' = krevetkalar.

points.en: Tomorrow, I'm taking the train to Pompeii to see the Roman sites. I'm also going to visit the Teatro di San Carlo opera house. I'm leaving Naples next Wednesday, so I'll call you then.
points.uz: Ertaga Rim yodgorliklarini ko'rish uchun Pompeyga poyezdda boraman. Teatro di San Karlo opera teatriga ham bormoqchiman. Neapoldan kelasi chorshanba ketaman, shunda senga qo'ng'iroq qilaman.
points.noteUz:
⚠ PARA 5 - Rejalar.
⚠ Continuous KELAJAK uchun: 'I'm taking', 'I'm leaving'.
⚠ 'going to visit' - niyat. 'I'll call' - va'da.

points.en: You really should visit Naples soon. It's a truly amazing city! See you soon.
points.uz: Tez orada Neapolga albatta kelishing kerak. Bu chindan ham ajoyib shahar! Tez orada ko'rishguncha.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the letter and answer the questions below.
exercises.instructionUz: Xatni o'qing va quyidagi savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
9 SAVOL - 6 XATBOShIGA:

  1-2 → Para 1 (shahar, turar joy)
  3-4 → Para 2 (ob-havo, vaqt)
  5-7 → Para 3-4 (odamlar, ovqat)
  8   → Para 5 (rejalar)
  9   → Para 6 (tavsiya)


⚠ 'WHAT ARE THEY LIKE?' vs
  'WHAT DO THEY LOOK LIKE?':

  5 'What are Neapolitans LIKE?' =
    xarakter → friendly, like
    having fun
  6 'What do they LOOK like?' =
    qiyofa → good-looking, dark
    hair, brown eyes


⚠ 'HOW DOES SHE SPEND HER TIME?':

  Javob: 'She spends most of her
  time ... walking ...' - 'spend' +
  V-ing.


⚠ 'HOW DOES SHE RECOMMEND':

  'to recommend' = tavsiya qilmoq.
  Javob - 6-xatboshidan.

items.question: Which city is Mary in?
items.whyUz: Para 1: 'I'm here in Naples on holiday!'

items.question: Where is she staying?

items.question: What's the weather like?
items.whyUz: Para 2: 'The weather here is quite warm.'

items.whyUz:
Para 2: 'I spend most of my time with the Bellinis, walking along the waterfront or around the old city.'
⚠ Javobda 'my' → 'her', 'I spend' → 'she spends'.

items.question: What are Neapolitans like?
items.answer: They are very friendly and they like having fun.
items.whyUz:
Para 3: 'They're very friendly and like having fun.'
⚠ 'What are they LIKE?' = xarakter.

items.question: What do they look like?
items.answer: They are quite good-looking. Most of them have got dark hair and brown eyes.
items.whyUz:
Para 3: 'They're quite good-looking, too. Most of them have got dark hair and brown eyes.'
⚠ 'look like' = qiyofa.

items.answer: They like eating pizza, pasta and seafood.

Para 5 - to'liq xatboshi.
⚠ 'I'm taking' → 'she is taking'.

items.whyUz: Para 6: 'You really should visit Naples soon. It's a truly amazing city!'

exercises.instructionEn: Read the letter in Ex. 15 again and mark the sentences as T (true) or F (false). Then correct the false sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: 15-mashqdagi xatni yana o'qing va gaplarni T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb belgilang. So'ng noto'g'ri gaplarni tuzating.
exercises.explanationUz:
DO'STONA XAT QOIDALARI
  (coursebook 9-bet Project bilan
  bir xil):

  1 Manzil - yuqori O'NG burchakda
    (chap EMAS!) → F
  2 Sana manzildan KEYIN yoziladi
    → F
  3 'Dear' + ism (Dear Carol) → T
  4 Xatboshilar BOR (6 ta) → F
  5 'Yours,' + ism bilan tugatish
    mumkin → T


⚠ 'THE TOP LEFT-HAND CORNER':

  = yuqori chap burchak.
  'right-hand' = o'ng.


⚠ 'THE RECIPIENT':

  = xat oluvchi (qabul qiluvchi).
  'to receive' = olmoq.


⚠ 'FIRST NAME':

  = ism (familiya = surname).
  Do'stona xatda faqat ISM.

items.sentence: We write our address in the top left-hand corner.
items.whyUz:
⚠ F. Manzil yuqori O'NG burchakda.
Tuzatish: 'We write our address in the top RIGHT-hand corner.'

items.sentence: We don't write the date after the address.
items.whyUz:
⚠ F. Xatda sana ('2nd August') manzildan KEYIN.
Tuzatish: 'We write the date after the address.'

items.sentence: We start with Dear + the recipient's first name.
items.whyUz: ⚠ T. 'Dear Carol,'.

⚠ F. Xatda 6 ta xatboshi bor (Para 1-6).
Tuzatish: 'There are six paragraphs.'

items.sentence: We can end with Yours + our first name.
items.whyUz: ⚠ T. 'Yours, Mary'.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the headings to the paragraphs.
exercises.explanationUz:
6 SARLAVHA - 6 XATBOShI.
  ⚠ Coursebook 9-bet 17-mashq bilan
  AYNAN bir xil tartib!

  1 Location/Accommodation
  2 Weather/Sights/Activities
  3 People (Looks/Character)
  4 Food
  5 Plans
  6 Recommendation

  ⚠ Bu tartib - do'stona xat REJASI.
  17-mashqda ham shu tartibda
  yoziladi.


⚠ 'ACCOMMODATION':

  = turar joy. Imlosi: IKKI 'c',
  IKKI 'm'.


⚠ 'SIGHTS':

  = diqqatga sazovor joylar.

exercises.instructionEn: Which of the phrases below can we use to end a friendly letter? Yours faithfully, Best wishes, Yours sincerely, Yours, Love, All the best.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi iboralardan qaysilarini do'stona xatni tugatish uchun ishlatishimiz mumkin? Yours faithfully, Best wishes, Yours sincerely, Yours, Love, All the best.
exercises.explanationUz:
XAT YAKUNLARI - RASMIY va
  DO'STONA.

  DO'STONA (friendly) - 4 ta:
    Yours,        - sening
    Love,         - mehr bilan
    Best wishes,  - eng yaxshi
                    tilaklar
    All the best, - hammasi yaxshi
                    bo'lsin

  RASMIY (formal) - 2 ta:
    Yours faithfully, - 'Dear Sir/
      Madam' bilan boshlangan xatda
      (ism NOMA'LUM)
    Yours sincerely,  - 'Dear Mr
      Smith' bilan boshlangan xatda
      (ism MA'LUM)


⚠ QOIDA:

  Dear Sir/Madam → Yours faithfully
  Dear Mr Brown  → Yours sincerely
  Dear John      → Yours / Love /
                   Best wishes


⚠ 'FAITHFULLY' / 'SINCERELY':

  faithful = sodiq; sincere =
  samimiy. Ikkalasi ham RASMIY
  xat uchun.

items.whyUz: ⚠ RASMIY - 'Dear Sir/Madam' xatida. Do'stona xatda ISHLATILMAYDI.
⚠ DO'STONA - mumkin.
⚠ RASMIY - 'Dear Mr/Mrs + familiya' xatida. Do'stona xatda ISHLATILMAYDI.
⚠ DO'STONA - 15-mashqdagi xat shunday tugagan.
⚠ DO'STONA - yaqin do'st/oila uchun.
⚠ DO'STONA - mumkin.

DO'STONA XAT - 6 XATBOShI
  (15-mashq qolipi):

  Manzil (o'ng burchak) + sana
  Dear + ism,
  1 Joylashuv/Turar joy
  2 Ob-havo/Manzaralar/Mashg'ulotlar
  3 Odamlar (qiyofa/xarakter)

  5 Rejalar
  6 Tavsiya
  Yours, / Love, + ism


⚠ QAYDLARNI TO'LIQ GAPGA
  AYLANTIRISh:

  'staying with the Serpas' →
    'I'm staying with the Serpas.'
  'hot & sunny' → 'The weather is
    hot and sunny.'
  'tomorrow - drive - Petrópolis' →
    'Tomorrow, I'm driving to
    Petrópolis.'


⚠ BRAZIL MANZILI:

  3 Avenida N.S. Copacabana =
    Kopakabana xiyoboni, 3-uy

⚠ 'SUGARLOAF MOUNTAIN':

  = Shakar noni tog'i (Pão de

⚠ PETRÓPOLIS:

  = Rio yaqinidagi tog' shahri,
  Braziliya imperatorlarining yozgi

⚠ 'SUCH A COLOURFUL CITY':

  'such a' + sifat + ot = shunday

⚠ 100-150 SO'Z - hisoblang!

modelAnswers:
3 Avenida N.S. Copacabana
CEP: 20394
Rio de Janeiro
Brazil

10th January, ...

Dear Carol,

I can't believe I'm here in Rio de Janeiro on holiday! I'm staying with the Serpas. They live in a lovely house in Copacabana near the beach. At the moment, I'm relaxing by the pool.

The weather here is hot and sunny. I spend most of my time exploring the city with the Serpas. We visit Sugarloaf Mountain and walk around the Botanical Gardens.

Brazilians are very friendly and happy. They love having fun. They're quite attractive, too. Most of them have got dark hair and brown eyes.

The food is delicious. Brazilians love spicy food. I love eating the tasty seafood here and the coffee is great!

Tomorrow, I'm driving to Petrópolis to enjoy the mountain air. I'm also going to visit the cathedral and the Museum of the Empire. I'm leaving Rio next week, so I'll call you then.

You really must come here soon. Rio is such a colourful city! See you soon.

Love,
Mary
